title: The Knicks Could Raise TWO Banners On One Night — And No Team Has EVER Done It
description:
The Knicks are the only team ever to win the NBA Championship and the Emirates NBA Cup in the same season — which means they could raise two banners on opening night at Madison Square Garden. No franchise has ever done it. We break down why Mike Brown refused to hang the Cup banner in 2025, why that decision looks different now, and why LeBron James walking into the Garden in a Sixers jersey makes the moment even bigger.

Then: why the Karl-Anthony Towns extension looks close, what the silence around the negotiation actually tells us, and why the Donovan Mitchell deal in Cleveland makes paying Jalen Brunson the easiest decision this front office will ever make.

Two banners or one? Tell us in the comments.
